items.title: Serve Robotics opens robot delivery network for others to build on
items.excerpt: Serve Robotics says its on-demand delivery API allows third parties to develop new delivery services on its fleet of more than 2,000 robots. The post Serve Robotics opens robot delivery network for others to build on appeared first on The Robot Report .

items.title: Memories.ai builds standardized egocentric video pipeline
items.excerpt: Memories.ai provides standardized egocentric video collection and AI-powered annotation to build training data infrastructure for robotics. The post Memories.ai builds standardized egocentric video pipeline appeared first on The Robot Report .

items.title: Can AI agents program industrial robots without training data? Berkeley says yes
items.excerpt: UC Berkeley and NVIDIA have released open-source tools for teams of AI coding agents that write, simulate, and refine readable robot programs. The post Can AI agents program industrial robots without training data? Berkeley says yes appeared first on The Robot Report .
